Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, hematuria, and bacteria on microscopy, suggesting a urinary tract infection (UTI). However, urine culture is negative, which may indicate prior antibiotic use or non-bacterial causes. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts are seen. Clinical correlation and repeat culture if symptoms persist are recommended.
